headline: A calmer panel: fewer lines, notes behind an "i", filters you choose, and Settings in 3 tabs.
notes: The "Before you hand off" note is now a small "i" beside Used
The extra "Also found" line is gone, since Imported twice and Empty bins already show their counts
Imported twice and Empty bins are now small dark buttons with icons, on one row under the totals, matching the clip view
Both used and not used bars are gone – the 2 big numbers say it, and the Media type bar stays
Click the small mark beside Used or Not used to open its note, and the × to close it
Used and Not used are now dark buttons, the same as the clip view, and the not used total is red like "never used"
Offline media gets its own button beside Empty bins
The Project tab no longer shows a count – offline media has its own button now
New: pin any filter in the Filters menu to keep it above the list, and unpin it from "On the panel" in the same menu
Imported twice, Empty bins and Offline can be unpinned too – they move into the Filters menu under Lists
Point at a pinned pin and it shows crossed out, so you know pressing it unpins
In Filters, "Kind" is now called "Media"
No filter appears twice any more: Offline, Imported twice and Used 2+ each show once
Buttons now react the moment you press them, not when you let go
Fixed: the clip view's use count now counts every use, including a clip used only once
Fixed: the clip view said "used in this cut" when All was selected
Fixed: with Active only on, an older cut you had open could be left out of the list
"Imported twice" is now called that everywhere
Fixed: a sequence you duplicate now shows up straight away, without a re-scan
Fixed: "Showing every sequence" no longer appears while Hide old is on
Fixed: pressing Enter on a pin no longer switches that filter on instead
Fixed: the Filters count no longer counts filters that do nothing in the view you are in
Fixed: an unpinned Offline button can be pinned back from Filters
Fixed: with Active only standing aside, Hide old now really hides the old cuts
Fixed: the Project view keeps itself up to date while nothing is selected
Fixed: clicking the clip that is already selected in Premiere now opens it from the Project view
In the clip view, notes like "also Camera 1 in Multicam_test" are now an "i" on the used count – click it to read them
All, Repeat and Other have icons, with Repeat and Other in the colours of their row tags
Build a sequence has a clearer icon, beside its words
The ☰ menu is grouped: the list, the scan, help, and Settings at the bottom
All uses, Repeat and Other now sit on their own row under the 2 big numbers, so Other never spills out of its box
The sequence buttons read All cuts, so they are not confused with All uses
All cuts, Active only and Hide old can be moved into Filters from "On the panel", and pinned back from there
Fixed: "Sequence filter" in Filters no longer shows as an empty heading
The multicam note in the Project view is now behind the "i" beside Used, not a yellow line
The explanations under Not placed, Imported twice and Empty bins are now an "i" beside the heading
New setting: Settings > Panel > Logo, to hide the Trace+ logo (shown by default)
Fixed: Settings showed its title twice
Fixed: a clip used right to its last frame no longer shows "0s never used"
Pins are only in the Filters menu now, so the buttons on the panel carry no pin
Settings has 3 tabs – Panel, Archive and Markers – and the on/off settings are switches
Every filter starts pinned above the list – unpin the ones you don't want from "On the panel" in Filters
Hide old now also hides older versions whose names end in "Copy 01" or a stray "_"
How many uses Hide old is hiding is now in the "i" on the used count, not a yellow line
Fixed: Build a sequence now works for audio files, like a WAV from a recorder
When every use of a clip is in an old cut, Hide old steps aside and shows them all – the "i" says why
The Settings tabs have short dividers and an underline, like VersionUp
